parameters.content:
## Discover High-MRR Paid Skool Communities & Enrich Creator Instagram/YouTube/LinkedIn Leads

**Actor:** [Skool Community & Creator Leads Scraper: Estimated MRR, Pricing & Socials](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-community-creator-leads-scraper)

### Production Multi-Branch Architecture (11 Nodes)
1. **Dual Triggers:** Daily 08:00 schedule or 1-click manual test.
2. **Apify Extraction:** Runs browserless HTTP scraper `skool-community-creator-leads-scraper`.
3. **Clean & Deduplicate:** Filters invalid items and removes duplicate leads.
4. **Custom JS Lead Scoring:** Assigns `lead_score` (0–100) + `priority_tier` using domain signals.
5. **Conditional Routing (`IF >= 70`):**
   - **Tier 1 (High Intent):** Generates AI personalized icebreaker via OpenAI API, pings Slack `#sales-alerts`, and upserts to Google Sheets.
   - **Tier 2 (Standard):** Logs directly to Google Sheets for batch nurturing.

### Related Pre-Built Apify Tasks
- [Skool Paid Community MRR & Pricing Calculator Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-paid-community-mrr-revenue-calculator-scraper)
- [Skool Creator Instagram, YouTube & Social Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-creator-instagram-youtube-email-leads-scraper)
- [Skool High-Commission Affiliate Communities Finder](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-affiliate-program-high-ticket-courses-finder)

## Step 1: API Credentials Setup

1. Sign in at [Apify Store — StoreIntel Labs](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-community-creator-leads-scraper) and copy your API token (`Settings -> Integrations`).
2. In **2. Run StoreIntel Scraper**, select **Header Auth** (`Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize targets & `min_priority_score` (`70`) in **1. Configure Target Parameters**.
4. Optional: Connect OpenAI **Bearer Auth** in node **7a** and **Slack OAuth2** in node **8a**.

## Step 2: Lead Intent Scoring & AI Routing

- **5. Compute Lead Intent Score (Code):** Inspects domain-specific high-intent signals (email reachability, pricing/MRR, churn rating, or enterprise tech stack) and calculates a 0–100 score.
- **6. Route by Priority Tier (IF):** Records scoring **≥ 70** branch upward for instant LLM personalization + real-time Slack alert before saving to CRM.
- Records below 70 bypass LLM costs and sync cleanly to Google Sheets.

## Free Browser Extensions & Ready CSV Packs

- [Shopify Product CSV Exporter & Theme Spy (Chrome/Edge)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/oemdcnkhnpjnpcbalcbfppeblfepnfdi)
- [Skool MRR Calculator & Community CSV Exporter (Chrome/Edge)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/emcboifchcknlchghjbafmiolpkklemb)
- [Free Live 246-Row Sample Datasets](https://mikrozar-cell.github.io/b2b-ecommerce-saas-scrapers-n8n-clay/samples.html)
- [Full Commercial B2B CSV Bundle ($49)](https://mikrozaar.gumroad.com/l/kevhup)
